elements.title: Vault core
elements.what: Folder skeleton (00-INBOX, 10-PROJECTS, 20-GOVERNANCE, 30-CLIENTS, systems) + CLAUDE.md charter + MEMORY.md + security baseline, naming and keeping-current SOPs + .spineosignore privacy list + Archive folder (vault/90-ARCHIVE) + removing-files SOP + delete guard (.claude/settings.json → .claude/hooks/delete-guard)

elements.title: Governance pack
elements.what: Governance starter, wiki-root rules, legal templates, persona retention templates

elements.title: Status dashboard
elements.what: Local single-file dashboard + status board data + refresh script

elements.title: Guided intake surface
elements.what: intake.html — structured intake/config page (feeds the vault, all local)

elements.title: Multi-AI charter
elements.what: AGENTS.md — rules for several AI tools sharing one vault without collisions

elements.title: AI onboarding prompts
elements.what: START-WITH-YOUR-AI.md — copy-paste prompt pack to boot any assistant governed

elements.title: Keep installer engine
elements.what: kit/wizard/ retained inside the vault for re-runs and repair

privacy.network_calls: none, except optional explicit de-identified install signal (see engine)
privacy.rule: personal/client/health data never goes into kit files; the vault holds it under its own governance post-install

persona_note: Engine keys in kit/wizard/provision.mjs RETENTION. "general" = not sure / other.

modules.ask: Do you want a tidy place for documents, letters and forms?
modules.what: vault/40-DOCUMENTS/ with templates, forms, reference and admin folders

modules.ask: Do you keep client or case files (for example clinical or social work)?
modules.what: Case folder template (summary, notes, plans, contacts, documents), private client-code key, case-files SOP

modules.ask: Would you like a reminders list your AI can check and turn into calendar alerts?
modules.what: vault/REMINDERS.md + reminders routine (makes .ics calendar files you double-click; nothing is sent)

modules.ask: Would you like email help (your AI drafts, you always press Send)?
modules.what: Email-help routine + 4 plain email templates; draft-only, no account connection

modules.ask: Add ready-made AI shortcuts (sort my inbox, find a file, what's due)?
modules.what: .claude/skills/: sort-inbox, find-it, case-note, whats-due, draft-email, weekly-review, privacy-check, keep-current

module_rules: Each installer asks every module question in plain English (non-interactive: SPINEOS_MODULES=a,b or none; provision.mjs: form.modules[]). Files land at the same relative path in the vault with the kit's no-clobber rules. Re-run the installer on the same folder to add one later.

removals.ask: When you or your AI remove a file, where should it go?

options.label: An Archive folder inside your vault (suggested)

removals.protocol: A permanent delete needs three steps in order: list exactly what and why · move the items to the Archive or Trash first · the person types "permanently delete" and names every item. Never via wildcards, bulk or parsed lists; holds even with full access or bypass permissions.
removals.guard: kit/.claude/hooks/delete-guard.mjs (Claude Code PreToolUse on Bash|PowerShell and Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit) — a safety net plus rules, not a guarantee; test kit/wizard/delete-guard-test.mjs
removals.guard_codex: kit/.codex/config.toml (approval_policy=untrusted, sandbox_mode=workspace-write) + AGENTS.md rules; no hook
